title: CAN FD Unpack
text: Unpack individual signals from CAN FD messages, 1 input, 1 output, {Data to output as} sets Select your; {Database file} sets the aRXML or CAN database file character, {Message list}, {Name} sets the message name CAN, {Identifier type}, {Identifier} sets the message identifier, {Length (bytes)} sets the cAN message length, {Add signal} adds CAN signal, {Delete signal} sets the remove CAN signal, {Signals}, {Output identifier} adds CAN ID output port, {Output timestamp} adds Timestamp output port, {Output error} adds Error output port, {Output remote} adds Remote output port, {Output length} adds Length output port, {Output status} adds Status output port, {Output Bit Rate Switch (BRS)} adds BRS output port, {Output Error Status Indicator (ESI)} adds ESI output port and {Output Data Length Code (DLC)} adds DLC output port. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Data
ports.summary: CAN message output single | double | int8 | int16 | int32 | int64 | uint8 | uint16 | uint32 | uint64 | boolean

params.name: Data to output as
params.values: Select your data signal raw data (default) | manually specify signals | CANdb specified signals | ARXML specified signals

params.name: Database file
params.values: ARXML or CAN database file character vector

params.name: Message list
params.values: Message list array of character vectors

params.name: Name
params.values: Message name CAN Msg (default) | character vector

params.name: Identifier type
params.values: Identifier type Standard (11-bit identifier) (default) | Extended (29-bit identifier)

params.values: Add CAN ID output port off (default) | on
